repooling.revisions_note: A repooling may add judgments; revising an existing grade would make the D4.2-D4.5 series incomparable without saying so. The guard rejects any revision, so this list is empty by construction.

score_terms_note: The real linear basis of compute_score. compactness and length_factor are absent because they are not summands: the first only gates table_row_bonus, the second multiplies fts_norm inside fts_component.

structure_bonus_availability.note: A document with no table_row chunk can never earn this bonus. Where such a document holds the correct evidence, the signal measures extraction quality rather than relevance.
